summary: Singleton (client and server, one holder each, present from level load in TUT_Avernus_C, WLD_Main_A, SCL_Main_A) holding the loaded navcloud regions: ls::HashMap<Vector3i<int>, navcloud::Region, navcloud::HashTableOps> (macOS signatures of navcloud::TryGetTileInfo / ToTilePos / GetNeighbors take exactly this map as the component). Written by navcloud::RegionSystem (ProcessMemoryData, ProcessObstacles, ProcessAgents, MetaDataRemoval), read by navcloud::PathfindingSystem. The map is written out member by member because its key is a struct (own structs may not be hash keys). Region (0x58 bytes, Windows dtor stride): +0 int32 tile resolution kind (0 -> 2, 1 -> 6 tiles per axis in TryGetTileInfo), +0x08 a 64-byte HashMap whose values are 48-byte HashSets, +0x48 Array<uint8_t> of per-tile data (index = (z*n + y)*n + x, bounded by the array size at +0x54).

fields.name: X
fields.evidence: Vector3i<int> key: macOS TryGetTileInfo compares *(int*)(keys + i*0xC + 0/4/8) with the tile position's region coordinates

fields.name: HashKeys
fields.evidence: bucket array (int32 per bucket) of the HashMap; creator bg3.exe+0x392A420 allocates 0x40 and zeroes it with the HashMap pattern (sizes at +0x1C/+0x2C); destructor thunk bg3.exe+0x6C8250 -> bg3.exe+0x6CFFB0 ends with the HashSet destructor bg3.exe+0x582AD0 on +0. Live: heap pointer.

fields.name: HashKeysSize
fields.evidence: bucket count; macOS TryGetTileInfo takes hash % *(int*)(map+8). Live server: 0x607 (1543 buckets)

fields.name: NextIds
fields.evidence: hash chain: TryGetTileInfo follows *(int*)(*(map+0x10) + i*4). Live: capacity 0x400, size 0

fields.name: Keys
fields.evidence: Vector3i<int> keys at *(map+0x20) stride 0xC, count *(int*)(map+0x2C) (macOS TryGetTileInfo; Windows dtor bg3.exe+0x6CFFB0 loops to *(int*)(this+0x2C)). Live: capacity 0x400, size 0

fields.name: Values
fields.evidence: navcloud::Region per key, stride 0x58: Windows dtor bg3.exe+0x6CFFB0 destroys *(this+0x30)+i*0x58 (Array at +0x48 freed, map at +0x08 destroyed by bg3.exe+0x5E19C0 whose values are 0x30-byte HashSets); macOS GetComponentDestructor<RegionDataComponent> calls navcloud::Region::~Region with the same stride

fields.name: ValuesCapacity
fields.evidence: size of the uninitialised value storage; live 0x400

open_questions: Live instances held an empty map (sizes 0, capacity 0x400): element boundaries of Region are untested live.
Key and value types of Region's inner map at +0x08 (values are 48-byte HashSets) and the 8 bytes at Region+0x00 beyond the int32 kind.
